recipes.name: Safe Feature Delivery
recipes.instructions: Map the project, identify the smallest coherent change surface, checkpoint before edits, implement, run available tests, repair bounded failures, compare regression baseline, and record evidence.

recipes.name: Root Cause Repair
recipes.instructions: Reproduce or isolate the symptom, gather evidence, identify the root cause before editing, make the narrowest reliable fix, test the exact failure path, then run broader regression checks.

recipes.name: Decision Brief
recipes.instructions: Separate facts, assumptions, constraints, options, tradeoffs, risks, and recommendation criteria. Preserve the final decision and rationale in the decision ledger.
